title: Opir: Efficient Multi-Task Safety Classification for Toxicity, Jailbreaks, Hate Speech, and Harmful Content

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates model performance across 23 different languages using translated safety benchmarks (e.g., PolyglotToxicityPrompts) to assess the consistency of safety classification across linguistic contexts.

The authors acknowledge potential variations in performance due to cultural context and dialect as a limitation, and evaluate model generalizability using a multilingual training and evaluation recipe.
The model is evaluated on its ability to classify 'hate_and_discrimination' content, specifically measuring its detection of protected class slurs, identity-based abuse, and supremacist claims.

The paper includes 'bias_fairness_and_representation' as one of its 16 top-level safety categories, evaluating the model's ability to identify content involving unfair treatment or discriminatory stereotypes.
